name: Dungeon Tail
source:
Enjoy a lewd dungeon romp through the Enchanted Caverns with Iris the bunny mage and Vyncent the wolf rogue, students of the prestigious Dungeon Delver Academy. Who knows what sorts of misadventures they'll run into~

[From [url=https://omegaozone.itch.io/dungeon-tail]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
兔族法师艾瑞丝和狼族盗贼文森特，是著名的地城探险学院的学生。与他们一起，在魔法洞窟中展开一场香艳的地城冒险吧。谁知道他们会遇到怎样的意外呢？

[摘自[url=https://omegaozone.itch.io/dungeon-tail]Itch.io[/url]]
